stem_book: Three springs, labeled (A), (B) and (C), are arranged as shown with three identical balls: on the left, spring (B) stands on the floor, a ball rests on it, spring (A) stands on that ball and a second ball rests on (A); on the right, spring (C) stands on the floor with the third ball on it. All the springs are parts cut from a single long spring such that A and B have equal natural length l but C has natural length 2l. All surfaces are smooth. Which spring is compressed by the smallest amount in equilibrium? (a) A (b) B (c) C (d) Cannot be determined with given information
work: k ∝ 1/length: k_A = k_B = k, k_C = k/2; x_A = mg/k, x_B = 2mg/k, x_C = mg/(k/2) = 2mg/k → A least
